race.comment: ISLAND DEC (3) is desperate for some sting out of the ground and looks to get the right set-up for this. Snagged back from the wide draw and wasn't that far away on the line when eighth over 1300m at Rosehill in Midway class. Tempo suits and can turn things around. BLUE MONDAY (8) resumes from a lengthy break. Had a throw at the stumps with a tidy seventh in the G3 James Carr over 1400m at Randwick two back. Goes well fresh and has genuine claims from the rails draw. SCENIC POINT (2) strongly fancied on resumption with a tough on pace fifth from the sticky draw over 1100m at Randwick in BM78 class. Since fitted with a 795m trial win at Warwick Farm. Can get the job done. REFLECT (1) smart mare who finished a close-up sixth in the G3 Kembla Grange Classic over 1600m last March. Slashing return when a narrow fifth over 1200m at Warwick Farm. Maps well again and will keep improving as she gets out in trip. Place best.
